title: Smallest Subarray With Sum ≥ Target
problem: Given an array of positive integers and a target, find the length of the smallest contiguous subarray whose sum is at least the target.

steps.message: Start with an empty window. sum = 0, best = ∞.
Window [0, 2] is valid with length 3. New best.
Try to shrink: drop nums[0] = 2. sum = 6, no longer valid.
Window [1, 3] is valid with length 3. Not better than 3.
Try to shrink: drop nums[1] = 1. sum = 7, still valid.
Window [2, 3] is valid with length 2. New best.
Try to shrink: drop nums[2] = 5. sum = 2, no longer valid.
Window [3, 5] is valid with length 3. Not better than 2.
Try to shrink: drop nums[3] = 2. sum = 5, no longer valid.
Right pointer reached the end. Answer: 2.
